Questions, feedback and conversations about the Geospatial Modelling
Workshop happen on our GitHub Discussions board. Applicants, alumni,
instructors and facilitators all read there — it's the fastest way to
get an answer that others can benefit from too.

## What to use it for

- **Programme questions.** Anything about the curriculum, prerequisites,
  or which edition to apply to.
- **Application help.** If something in the application portal is
  unclear, ask before you submit rather than after.
- **After the workshop.** Alumni share how they are applying the
  methods in their own work; new applicants read those threads before
  applying.

## Not sure whether to post?

If your question is likely to be useful to more than one person, post
it in the discussion. If it is strictly personal (a change of email,
a specific document), reach out on the [Contact](#) page instead.
